virtio-rng.scope: Translate Linux VirtIO RNG hardware behavior into the existing Asterinas entropy-device API. Preserve DMA ownership, refill/completion and blocking/nonblocking semantics required by the unchanged hwrng caller. Pass all original hwrng.c regression functions in the rebuilt full kernel with virtio-rng-pci; device-unavailable skips are not acceptance.

virtio-blk.scope: Translate Linux VirtIO Block into the retained Asterinas block-device API: initialization and capacity, DMA request ownership, read/write completion, error status and flush as supported by the frozen QEMU features. Boot with the translated block driver and pass every function in the unchanged block_device.c, ext2/file_io.c and ext2/short_rw.c regression files.

virtio-net.scope: Translate Linux VirtIO Network into the retained target network API. Provide initialization, MAC, bounded RX/TX buffer ownership, completion/recycling, and interrupt progress for the pinned upstream feature profile. Complete all three unmodified upstream host/guest iperf3 scripts with actual nonzero sender/receiver traffic.

nvme-pci.scope: PCI NVMe controller and namespace initialization, request completion and native direct-I/O filesystem regression. Embedded ktests are a separate, not-yet-enabled evaluation layer.

virtio-vsock.reason: Host lacks /dev/vhost-vsock; excluded before translation, no transport substitution
